text:
Maya (Marketing Ops): Diego just alerted about higher-than-normal latency in eu-west. Need quick alignment: status page wording, whether to pause today's benchmark post, and lead routing for EU signups. @Diego @Asha @Ollie
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-047 created 1776029800Z 1776029800Z - Elevated latency observed in eu-west affecting inference endpoints
Diego (SRE): Root cause appears to be proxy connection queue saturation. Rolling restarts + scale in progress. ETA ~30m to 45m. No data loss detected.
Asha (CS): Recommend immediate status page update + direct email to Dedicated/Public sector customers if unresolved at 60m. Also drafting CS talking points.
Ollie (Growth): Pause the benchmark publish and the performance-focused outreach scheduled for EU audiences. Also flag any new demo requests from EU to the EU SDR queue.
Claire (Product): For the webinar demo at 09:00 CET, switch to recording for the live demo portion; keep live Q&A. Notify registrants with short note.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Draft status copy options: 1) "Degraded performance in EU (eu-west). We're mitigating increased latency; some requests may be slower." 2) "We're investigating elevated latency in EU; services are available with degraded performance." Which is clearer?
Diego (SRE): Option 1 + add: "No data loss reported." Keep it short on the main banner, full details in the incident body.
Asha (CS): Email subject for Dedicated customers: "Redwood: Elevated latency in EU 1776029800" Body: short ack, ETA, contact link.
Ollie (Growth): Lead routing: tag incoming EU leads as "incident-eu-2026-047" and assign to EU reps. I'll create the rule now.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Proposed timing: publish initial status now (T+5), follow-up at T+30, send Dedicated email at T+60 if not resolved. Hold social and benchmark posts until cleared. Approve?
Diego (SRE): Approved. Please do not post external comms that promise resolution time.
Claire (Product): +1 on webinar workaround.
Asha (CS): +1 on cadence. CS playbook bullets: acknowledge, ETA, escalation path, credits policy if production impact >2h.
Ollie (Growth): Paused campaigns and set routing. Will confirm within 3m.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Publishing status page now. Hold social; email template in draft. Will update thread with status page URL and timestamps. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai at 2026-03-21T16:10:05Z
Maya (Marketing Ops): Posted. Follow-up scheduled for 16:40 UTC. I'll post the Dedicated email when it's sent.
Asha (CS): Dedicated email queued for 17:10 UTC if unresolved. CS playbook saved to internal drive and linked in the follow-up.
Diego (SRE): Latency improving after scale. Still monitoring for spikes. Will post next update at T+30.
Maya (Marketing Ops): Thanks everyone. Keeping thread as the single source of truth for comms.
